implementation.values: Bounded 18px / opacity .75 image entry over 700ms, or 2px clarity entry over 650ms. Reconstruction estimates; source editor values unavailable. Once-entry; normal reverse scroll. No pinning.

motion_contract.reverse: Timed first-entry does not replay; declared focus recomputes on scroll and reverses. Native content remains visible.
motion_contract.mobile: No mobile pin added; same semantic order in native flow.
motion_contract.limitations: These are restrained source-mechanism adaptations, not unique arbitrary heading axes. Exact Framer editor timings unavailable.
